HIGH COURT OF DELHI AT NEW DELHI
No. 03/SCMSC/DHC/2026 Dated: 08.10.2026
PRACTICE DIRECTIONS
Hon’ble the Acting Chief Justicehas been pleased to issue the following
Practice Directions for information and compliance by all concerned:-
“In order to reduce the pendency of Execution
Petitions, all Courts dealing with Execution Petitions/
applications are directed to ensure that such cases are
not adjourned beyond a period of 30 days. In case, for
any unavoidable reason, an adjournment beyond 30
days is considered necessary, brief reasons for granting
such adjournment shall be recorded by the Presiding
Officer of such Court.
If the proceedings have been stayed by the High
Court or the Supreme Court, adjournment shall
ordinarily not be granted by the District Court beyond a
period of 90 days. However, while granting the
adjournment, the relevant details, including the case
number and the date of the order whereby the
proceedings have been stayed by the High Court or the
Supreme Court, shall be duly recorded by the Presiding
Officer of such Court.”
By Order
Sd/-
(REETESH SINGH)
REGISTRAR GENERAL
